# Ultraterrestrial Resurrection – Comprehensive Codebase Analysis

---

## 1. Project Overview

**Type:**  
- Monorepo, multi-app, research and data analysis platform

**Primary Technologies:**  
- **Frontend:** Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn UI  
- **Backend:** Node.js, Python (for RAG/AI), Bun (for some packages)  
- **AI/ML:** OpenAI, Anthropic, Firecrawl, Exa AI, custom agentic research framework  
- **Database:** Xata (primary), with registry pattern for future extensibility (Supabase, Convex, etc.)

**Main Purpose:**  
- UFO/UAP research, knowledge management, data visualization, AI-powered analysis, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).

**Target Deployment:**  
- Vercel or Node/Docker (serverless-ready), with Python-based RAG system deployable via standard Python tooling.

---

## 2. Architecture Analysis

### Monorepo Structure

- **apps/**
  - `app/` – Main Next.js application (user-facing, data-viz, AI features)
  - `cli/` – CLI tools and scripts
  - `disclosure-rag/` – Python RAG system (AI, research agents, knowledge base)
- **packages/**
  - `db/` – Shared TypeScript DB access (Xata, registry, models, types)
  - `ai/` – (WIP) Shared AI utilities
  - `knowledge-base/` – (WIP) Shared knowledge base logic

### Directory Patterns

- **Next.js App Router**:  
  - `src/app/(site)/` – Main site routes (explore, history, sightings, timeline, whiteboard)
  - `src/app/api/` – API route handlers (chat, disclosure, admin, processing)
  - `src/features/` – Modular feature directories (3d, ai, mindmap, case-files, etc.)
  - `src/services/` – Service integrations (AI, processing, knowledge, sightings, etc.)
  - `src/lib/` – Third-party integrations (OpenAI, Anthropic, Firecrawl, etc.)

- **Python RAG System** (`apps/disclosure-rag/`):  
  - `agents/` – Specialized AI research agents (extraction, analysis, orchestration)
  - `lib/` – Shared libraries (RAG, OpenAI, Upstash, Xata, etc.)
  - `processing/` – Document and content processing modules
  - `research/` – Research prompts, workflows, NER tools
  - `docs/` – Documentation and research methodologies

### Architectural Patterns

- **Modular, Feature-based**: Each feature (e.g., mindmap, data-viz, AI) is self-contained.
- **Registry Pattern**: For database providers, enabling easy extension.
- **Agentic AI**: Python RAG system uses a composable agent framework for research, analysis, and orchestration.
- **Separation of Concerns**: UI, business logic, and data access are clearly separated.

### Data Flow & Communication

- **Frontend**:  
  - Server Components for data fetching, minimal client-side JS.
  - SWR/React Query for client-side data fetching.
  - Server Actions preferred for mutations and AI calls.
- **Backend**:  
  - API routes only for webhooks/external integrations.
  - Python RAG system exposes CLI and scriptable interfaces.
- **Database**:  
  - All access via shared registry and model APIs.
  - Type-safe, extensible, and ready for multi-provider support.

---

## 3. Code Quality Assessment

- **Coding Standards**:  
  - TypeScript type safety enforced.
  - Named exports for all functions/utilities.
  - PascalCase for components, lowercase-with-dashes for directories.
  - Functional programming patterns, no class-based React.
  - SOLID principles applied (see user rules).
- **Organization & Modularity**:  
  - High modularity, clear separation of features and services.
  - Shared logic in packages, not duplicated across apps.
- **Testing**:  
  - Python: Pytest, coverage, linting, type checks (see `.github/workflows/test.yml`).
  - TypeScript: Jest/React Testing Library (expected, not all tests visible).
- **Documentation**:  
  - Extensive Markdown docs in `docs/`, `tickets/`, and package roots.
  - All tickets and features documented with objectives, technical details, and references.
- **Performance**:  
  - Server Components, streaming, and caching strategies in Next.js.
  - Python: Async processing, efficient data pipelines.

---

## 4. Technical Stack

- **Frontend:**  
  - Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn UI, Three.js, react-three-fiber, GSAP
- **Backend:**  
  - Node.js (TypeScript), Bun (for some packages)
  - Python 3.9–3.12 (RAG, agents, CLI)
- **AI/ML:**  
  - OpenAI, Anthropic, Firecrawl, Exa AI, Mem0, custom agentic research framework
- **Database:**  
  - Xata (primary, via `@db` package), registry pattern for future providers
- **Build Tools & CI/CD:**  
  - Bun, npm, GitHub Actions (Python: lint, type check, test, coverage)
- **Dev Dependencies:**  
  - ESLint, Prettier, Black, Flake8, Mypy, Pytest, Codecov

---

## 5. Key Components

### Core Business Logic

- **AI Agents (Python, `apps/disclosure-rag/agents/`)**:  
  - Extraction, analysis, orchestration, and specialized agents (historical, evidence, geospatial, network, etc.)
  - Prompts and configuration in `prompts.py`
  - Agent registry and factory pattern for dynamic agent creation

- **Knowledge Base (Python, `lib/knowledge_base.py`, `lib/knowledge_base_crud.py`)**:  
  - CRUD, search, and retrieval for documents, transcripts, articles, research
  - Vector store integration for semantic search

- **Processing Pipelines (Python, `processing/`)**:  
  - Content analysis, entity recognition, topic classification, web content processing

- **Database Models (TypeScript, `packages/db/xata/models/`)**:  
  - CRUD and search for all major entities: topics, personnel, events, organizations, sightings, testimonies, documents, etc.
  - Bulk operations, advanced queries, and error handling

- **API & Integration (TypeScript, `packages/db/xata/api/`)**:  
  - AI-powered queries (`askXataWithAi`), XYFlow integration, streaming, and research utilities

### UI Components

- **Next.js App**:  
  - Modular pages for explore, history, sightings, timeline, whiteboard
  - Feature-based components (3d, mindmap, data-viz, etc.)
  - UI library: shadcn UI, custom components, Tailwind CSS

### Utility Functions

- **TypeScript**:  
  - Utility functions for data transformation, graph/flow conversion, error handling
- **Python**:  
  - Tools for file processing, vector operations, YouTube transcript extraction, etc.

---

## 6. Codebase Instructions for Another Agent

### Finding Critical Files & Functions

- **Tickets & Docs:**  
  - All work is tracked in `tickets/` (see `00-Overview.md` for project status and dependencies)
  - Documentation in `docs/` and package roots
- **Database Access:**  
  - Use `@db` package for all DB operations (see `QUICK_REFERENCE.md` and `NOTES.md`)
- **AI/Research Agents:**  
  - Python agents in `apps/disclosure-rag/agents/`, with prompts in `prompts.py`
- **Feature Development:**  
  - Add new features in `src/features/<feature>/` (Next.js app)
  - Use modular structure: `components/`, `hooks/`, `utils/`, `store/`, `actions/`
- **Testing:**  
  - Python: Add tests in `tests/`, use Pytest
  - TypeScript: Co-locate tests with components, use Jest/React Testing Library
- **Deployment & Environment:**  
  - Use `.env` for secrets (never expose on client)
  - Python: Install dependencies, run via CLI or scripts
  - Next.js: Deploy via Vercel or Docker
- **Patterns & Idioms:**  
  - Functional, declarative code; named exports; SOLID principles
  - Use Server Actions for mutations, Server Components for data fetching
- **Error Handling:**  
  - Robust, informative errors; custom error types where appropriate
- **Database Interaction:**  
  - All access via registry and model APIs; never direct DB calls in components
- **API Usage:**  
  - Prefer Server Actions; use API routes only for webhooks/external integrations
- **State Management:**  
  - Local state where possible; React context or Zustand for global state
- **Security:**  
  - Sanitize all user input; use authentication/authorization in protected routes

---

## 7. Development Workflow

- **Git:**  
  - Feature branches, PRs for all changes, code review required before merge, descriptive commit messages
- **CI/CD:**  
  - Linting, type checks, tests on PRs, coverage reporting, deploy via Vercel/Docker
- **Environment Management:**  
  - `.env` for secrets, never expose on client, use `next-env.d.ts` for type safety
- **Debugging:**  
  - Next.js error overlays, browser devtools, logging, Python logging and breakpoints

---

## 8. Known Issues & Technical Debt

- **Legacy Code:**  
  - Some legacy code may not follow new conventions—refactor as you go
- **Duplication:**  
  - Watch for duplicated utility functions across features
- **Validation:**  
  - Ensure all API endpoints have proper validation and error handling
- **Performance:**  
  - Review performance of data-viz and 3D features for bottlenecks
- **Migration:**  
  - Ongoing migration of `disclosure-rag-recovered` to `disclosure-rag` (see tickets 47–51)
- **Testing Coverage:**  
  - Some areas may lack full test coverage, especially in newly migrated or legacy code

---

## 9. Context for New Agent

- **Project History:**  
  - Salvaged and reconstructed from markdown and legacy code; ongoing migration and refactor
- **Recent Changes:**  
  - Major migration of chat modules, automation scripts, and documentation from `disclosure-rag-recovered`
  - Refactoring of Firecrawl and Exa AI integrations
- **Current Priorities:**  
  - Complete migration of RAG modules (tickets 47–51)
  - Integrate Firecrawl and Exa AI into unified research package
  - Improve documentation and onboarding
- **Future Roadmap:**  
  - Expand agentic research capabilities
  - Enhance data visualization and knowledge graph features
  - Unify database modules and improve type safety
- **Team Conventions:**  
  - All work tracked via tickets, documented in markdown, and reviewed before merge
  - Consistent naming, modularity, and adherence to SOLID and functional programming principles
